LESSON: MILAD UN-NABI

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.1: Milad un-Nabi

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Milad un-Nabi. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. mention the activities that take place during Aqiqah ceremony as taught by the Prophet 147 (S.A.W).
2. Appreciate Milad un-Nabi celebrations as a way of learning the life history of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
3. Appreciate Aqiqah as an Islamic ritual for all children

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. mention the activities that take place during Aqiqah ceremony as taught by the Prophet 147 (S.A.W).
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to mention the activities that take place during Aqiqah ceremony as taught by the Prophet 147 (S.A.W). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Appreciate Milad un-Nabi celebrations as a way of learning the life history of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate Milad un-Nabi celebrations as a way of learning the life history of the Prophet (S.A.W.). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Appreciate Aqiqah as an Islamic ritual for all children
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate Aqiqah as an Islamic ritual for all children. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Milad un-Nabi.
2. Explain Milad un-Nabi to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.

4. Show that you can: mention the activities that take place during Aqiqah ceremony as taught by the Prophet 147 (S.A.W).
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Milad un-Nabi. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Milad un-Nabi important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
